intro.heading: We started in June 2026
intro.body: That's not a footnote we're hoping you'll skip — it's the first thing you should know about us. We'd rather you judge us on how we work than on a number of years we don't have yet.

whyWeExist.heading: Why we exist
whyWeExist.body: Most agencies help you get admitted, then stop. The real risk starts after that: a visa file that has to meet a consulate's exact standard, an 8-day deadline that begins the moment you land, and a housing market that treats international students as a liability. We built Kimere to cover exactly that gap — the part between acceptance and actually being settled.

principles.title: Diagnose first
principles.body: On the call, we look at your country, your course, and your timeline before we tell you what you need — not a generic package.

principles.title: Plan against real deadlines
principles.body: Universitaly windows, consulate appointments, the 8-day filing deadline — we work backward from the dates that don't move.

principles.title: Handle the paperwork with you
principles.body: We prepare files, book appointments, and — where it matters, like your fiscal code — show up with you in person.

principles.title: Stay reachable after you land
principles.body: The job isn't done at the visa. We're there for registration, health cover, and the housing paperwork that follows.

whatWeDontDo.heading: What we don't do
items: We don't issue visas or guarantee outcomes — that decision belongs to the consulate.
We're not a licensed real estate agency.
We don't give legal or tax advice as a substitute for a qualified professional — we point you to official sources and help you act on them.
